purpose: Teach: 砂利/空き地/ニキビ/小指/左下/レディース/インナー/レザー

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、自転車で砂利に滑ってこけたな
lines.en: Riku, you totally ate gravel on your bike.
lines.style: Teasing but not mean. Quick rhythm, eyebrow-raised delivery. Sharp and affectionate, like catching him out on something small and dumb.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、近所の空き地で野球してたな、桜
lines.en: You were the one playing baseball in that empty lot near school, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry counter-attack. Flat tone, slight smirk underneath. Deliberate and calm — he's been waiting to say this. Not defensive, just even.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、最近ニキビ気にしてたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you worrying about acne last week.
lines.style: Wry, knowing lilt. Casual cruelty that's actually affection. Eyes bright. The cadence of someone who notices everything and saves it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、小指の腹をぶつけてたろ、桜
lines.en: You smashed your pinky finger into a locker, Sakura.
lines.style: Flat delivery with the faintest smile. Not gloating — just matching her energy exactly. Steady eye contact. He's been waiting for this one too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テスト用紙の左下に名前忘れたろ
lines.en: Riku, you forgot to write your name on the test and didn't even notice.
lines.style: Sharp laugh riding under the words. Quick attack. Relish in the small failure. Warm underneath it all — this is what they do.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ショッピングモールのレディース階で迷子になったろ、桜
lines.en: You got completely lost on the ladies' floor of the mall, Sakura.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate delivery. Each word distinct. Barely suppressed laughter. The satisfaction of a perfect setup. Not loud — quiet and deadly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、部活でインナーTシャツ重ね着してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were wearing like three layers of undershirt at practice.
lines.style: Observant, curious tone. Not mocking — genuinely noting something she noticed. Softer than the teasing before. Like asking without asking.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、レザーのスマホケース使ってたな、桜
lines.en: You had that fancy leather phone case, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost tender. Noticing something she was proud of. Close and warm — he remembers what matters to her. Not teasing here.
